name: AWG TMS Unified Interfaces
description:
**New Version Available: https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/e6integrations-6a1/awg-tms-unified-objects/1.10.0**

AutoWallis TMS Unified API specification for Middleware platform to communicate with Logistics Service Provider (LSP), Transport Management System (TMS), Progression System (ERP), Data Warehouse (DWH) and Finance and Accounting (F&A) Systems.

**Authentication:** All middleware endpoints will be secured using Client ID–based authentication. Downstream and upstream systems may implement their own authentication mechanisms. The middleware layer should adapt to support these system-specific authentication methods.

**Important Note:** The API endpoint names referenced in this document are indicative and represent the intended functionality only. Participating systems are free to define and use their own endpoint naming conventions. The middleware must adapt accordingly. The primary focus should be on validating, mapping, adapting the API request/response fields and success/error behaviour.
